text: Review quality documentation necessary for regulatory submissions and inspections.
Write grants to procure external funding, and supervise grant-funded projects.
Design, weld, and fabricate parts, using blueprints or other mechanical plans.
Compile, analyze, and report data to explain economic phenomena and forecast market trends, applying mathematical models and statistical techniques.
Observe machine operations, control boards, and gauges to detect malfunctions such as clogged bushings and defective binder applicators.
Draft speeches for company executives and arrange interviews and other forms of contact for them.
Provide patients with information about the inheritance of conditions such as cardiovascular disease, Alzheimer's disease, diabetes, and various forms of cancer.
Check equipment to ensure that it meets health and safety regulations, and perform maintenance or cleaning, as necessary.
Analyze revenue and program cost data to determine budget priorities.
Record sales or delivery information on daily sales or delivery record.
Analyze the strengths and weaknesses of opposing teams to develop game strategies.
Adjust equipment controls to generate specified amounts of electrical power.
Select and assign instructors to conduct training.

Notify supervisors or other personnel of production problems.
Research or investigate products to be presented to prepare for demonstrations.
Conduct medical research to aid in controlling and curing disease, to investigate new medications, and to develop and test new medical techniques.
Prepare and maintain required records, including logs of parking enforcement activities, and records of contested citations.
Report any vehicle malfunctions or needed repairs.
Verify signatures and required information on checks.
Calculate premiums and establish payment method.
Coordinate sales promotion activities, such as preparing merchandise displays and advertising copy.
Prepare checks that itemize and total meal costs and sales taxes.
Add radioactive substances to biological specimens, such as blood, urine, or feces, to determine therapeutic drug or hormone levels.
Develop treatment plans based on patients' histories and goals, the nature and severity of disorders, and treatment risks and benefits.
Identify and report safety concerns to maintain a safe shopping and working environment.
Operate car washes.
Update client and server applications responsible for integration and business logic.
Report and document safety hazards, potentially hazardous conditions, and unsafe practices and procedures.
Plan or direct activities, such as sales promotions, that require coordination with other department managers.
Clean, oil, or coat system components, as necessary, before assembly or attachment.
Operate pumps connected to high-pressure hoses.
Calibrate testing instruments and installed or repaired equipment to prescribed specifications.
Provide guidance to agencies and organizations on assessment of health education needs and on development and delivery of health education programs.
Research production specifications, costs, production materials, and manufacturing methods and provide cost estimates and itemized production requirements.
Direct operating or maintenance activities of nuclear power plants to ensure efficiency and conformity to safety standards.
Monitor employees' work schedules and attendance for payroll purposes.
Analyze information obtained from management to conceptualize and define operational problems.
Implement or monitor complaint processing systems to ensure effective and timely resolution of all complaint investigations.
Examine objects to be included in exhibits to plan where and how to display them.
Test samples to determine viscosity, acidity, specific gravity, or degree of concentration, using test equipment such as viscometers, pH meters, or hydrometers.

Select locations and plan underground or surface mining operations, specifying processes, labor usage, and equipment that will result in safe, economical, and environmentally sound extraction of minerals and ores.
Repair, maintain, and replace parts on dies.
Perform business management duties, such as maintaining records or files, preparing reports, or ordering supplies or equipment.
Present new game design concepts to management and technical colleagues, including artists, animators, and programmers.
Monitor operations to ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, or hygiene standards.
Perform maintenance and minor repairs on firefighting equipment, including vehicles, and write and submit proposals to modify, replace, and repair equipment.

Educate, prepare, and reassure patients and their families by answering questions, providing physical assistance, and reinforcing physicians' advice regarding treatment reactions or post-treatment care.
